tasks.title: Georeferencing error from a frame/attitude desync
tasks.solution: The angular error is δθ = ω·Δt; the shift near nadir is δ = h·tan(δθ). At 15 m, 25 °/s and 100 ms that is 0.65 m, an order of magnitude more than the pixel error.

tasks.title: Target size in pixels and the maximum altitude
tasks.solution: The size in pixels is s = D·f/h ⇒ h_max = D·f/s. An 80 cm disc at f = 400 px with a 10 px minimum gives 32 m; the detector's area gates are computed from the same formula.

tasks.title: Glass-to-command latency and the gain limit
tasks.solution: T_d = the sum of the stages (in seconds). For a "position error → velocity" loop with a pure delay, the −90° phase is reached at ω = π/(2·T_d), and that is the K_p limit without the autopilot's dynamics; with a velocity response τ = 0.4 s and limits it is lower (per-tracking), and the working value is another 3–5 times smaller.
